import json,sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('D:/作品集/ResearchOS/research-os/execution/v2.4/receipts/W05/W05-99/integration_codex/root-model-trial-v5-870ecc93e109c85ee985e1566ff')
ad=json.loads((base/'trial-output/host.admitted.json').read_bytes())
dbpath=Path('D:/作品集/ResearchOS/research-os/.local/mu-sdk-isolated-project-ed84838046934329a76733a005c9b162/researchos.sqlite')
db=sqlite3.connect(dbpath.as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=1);db.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
try:
 tables=[r[0] for r in db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'") if any(k in r[0] for k in ('runtime','effect','model','ledger'))]
 schemas={t:[r[1] for r in db.execute('PRAGMA table_info('+t+')')] for t in tables}
 runfields=('id','project_id','task_id','runtime_id','status','lease_epoch','created_at','started_at','completed_at','model_request_count','provider_request_count','model_requests','effect_count','output_artifact_ids')
 # Whitelist projection prevents materializing lease/token fields from the Run body.
 runsql="SELECT "+",".join("json_extract(body,'$."+k+"')" for k in runfields)+" FROM domain_objects WHERE project=? AND kind='Run' AND id=?"
 run=[dict(zip(runfields,r)) for r in db.execute(runsql,(ad['project_id'],ad['qualification_run_id']))]
 taskfields=('id','project_id','goal_id','status','active_run_id','task_type','acceptance_id')
 tasksql="SELECT "+",".join("json_extract(body,'$."+k+"')" for k in taskfields)+" FROM domain_objects WHERE project=? AND kind='Task' AND id=?"
 task=[dict(zip(taskfields,r)) for r in db.execute(tasksql,(ad['project_id'],ad['qualification_task_id']))]
 print(json.dumps({'query_only':db.execute('PRAGMA query_only').fetchone()[0],'schemas':schemas,'run':run,'task':task},ensure_ascii=True))
finally:db.close()

import json,sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('D:/作品集/ResearchOS/research-os/execution/v2.4/receipts/W05/W05-99/integration_codex/root-model-trial-v5-870ecc93e109c85ee985e1566ff');ad=json.loads((base/'trial-output/host.admitted.json').read_bytes())
db=sqlite3.connect(Path('D:/作品集/ResearchOS/research-os/.local/mu-sdk-isolated-project-ed84838046934329a76733a005c9b162/researchos.sqlite').as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=1);db.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
try:
 project,run=ad['project_id'],ad['qualification_run_id']
 keys=('project','run','epoch','state','worker','journal_locator','identity','observation_sequence','observation_hash','prepared_at','updated_at','reason')
 dispatch=[dict(zip(keys,r)) for r in db.execute('SELECT '+','.join(keys)+' FROM runtime_dispatches WHERE project=? AND run=?',(project,run))]
 markerkeys=('project','task','run','runtime','epoch','plan_hash','profile_hash','contract_hash','input_hash','context_bundle','owner_root')
 markers=[dict(zip(markerkeys,r)) for r in db.execute('SELECT '+','.join(markerkeys)+' FROM runtime_qualification_runs WHERE project=? AND run=?',(project,run))]
 counts={t:db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM '+t+' WHERE project=? AND run=?',(project,run)).fetchone()[0] for t in ('resource_effects','runtime_observations','runtime_uploads')}
 counts['project_resource_effects']=db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM resource_effects WHERE project=?',(project,)).fetchone()[0]
 counts['project_BudgetLedgerEntry']=db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM domain_objects WHERE project=? AND kind='BudgetLedgerEntry'",(project,)).fetchone()[0]
 counts['project_Run']=db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM domain_objects WHERE project=? AND kind='Run'",(project,)).fetchone()[0]
 counts['project_Acceptance']=db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM domain_objects WHERE project=? AND kind='Acceptance'",(project,)).fetchone()[0]
 counters={k:db.execute("SELECT json_type(body,?) FROM domain_objects WHERE project=? AND kind='Run' AND id=?",('$.'+k,project,run)).fetchone()[0] for k in ('model_request_count','provider_request_count','model_requests')}
 print(json.dumps({'query_only':db.execute('PRAGMA query_only').fetchone()[0],'dispatch':dispatch,'qualification_marker':markers,'counts':counts,'dedicated_run_counter_json_types':counters,'provider_requests_total':None,'model_requests_recorded_as_resource_effects':0 if counts['resource_effects']==0 else None},ensure_ascii=True))
finally:db.close()
